q1_issues.issue: Strength 0.0 states that success never accompanies fame, but 'not always' denies only the universal — the negation is scoped over the frequency adverb, not over the predication, so the parse asserts a strictly stronger and different claim.

q2_gaps: negated frequency adverb over a generic ('not always', and equally 'usually / often / rarely') — the quantifier-to-strength table covers nominal determiners only, and Every / TimesPer covers calendar schedules, so adverbial frequency quantification has no mapping
negation of a kind-level relational generic — the Striking & relational section fixes only the positive high-strength form and says nothing about denying one
notes: Accompany is licensed as a kind-level relational generic head (bare mass NP on each side), and the passive by-phrase correctly fills the slot its active subject would.
